title: Schedule of Included Care and Care Add-On Prices, Memory Care Residency Agreement
content:
Each tier of the Memory Care Residency Agreement includes its own set of care in the all-inclusive monthly rate and prices its own care add-ons, as scheduled below. Monthly fees are in US dollars per calendar month; a fee shown as 0.00 means the care is included in that tier.

## Services included without charge

| Tier | Medication management included | Coordination with an outside hospice provider included | Incontinence supplies included |
|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | Yes | Yes | No |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | Yes | Yes | No |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Monthly care add-ons (USD per calendar month)

| Tier | Incontinence supplies | Insulin administration | Individualized behavioral support plan | Two-person assist for transfers |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 245.00 | 395.00 | 275.00 | 450.00 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 0.00 | 395.00 | 0.00 | 450.00 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 245.00 | 395.00 | 275.00 | 450.00 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 0.00 | 395.00 | 0.00 | 450.00 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## One-to-one companion care

| Tier | Hours included per calendar month | Rate per hour beyond the included hours (USD) | Minimum hours billed per scheduled shift |
|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 0 | 32.50 | 4 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 0 | 32.50 | 4 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 0 | 32.50 | 4 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 0 | 32.50 | 4 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 4 | 32.50 | 4 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 8 | 32.50 | 4 |

## Reading the schedule by program

- **Essential program** (companion or private suite): incontinence supplies are priced at 245.00 a month, insulin administration at 395.00, a behavioral support plan at 275.00 and two-person assist at 450.00; no one-to-one hours are included.
- **Enhanced program** (companion or private suite): incontinence supplies and the behavioral support plan are included (0.00); insulin administration remains 395.00 and two-person assist 450.00; no one-to-one hours are included.
- **Advanced program** (private or deluxe suite): every monthly care add-on on this schedule is included (0.00); the private suite includes 4 one-to-one hours a month and the deluxe suite 8.
- Medication management and hospice coordination are included on every tier.
